-- Tower of Hanoi implementation in Lua

local function towerOfHanoi(n, source, destination, auxiliary)
    -- Base case: if there's only 1 disk
    if n == 1 then
        print(f"Disk {n} moved from {source} to {destination}")
        return
    end

    -- Recursive step: move n-1 disks to auxiliary
    towerOfHanoi(n - 1, source, auxiliary, destination)

    -- Move the nth disk to destination
    print(f"Disk {n} moved from {source} to {destination}")

    -- Move the remaining n-1 disks from auxiliary to destination
    towerOfHanoi(n - 1, auxiliary, destination, source)
end

-- Display the tower setup
local function displayTower()
    local tower = {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local disk = "0"
        for k = 1, i do
            disk = tostring(k)
        end
        tower[i] = disk
    end
    print("Tower Configuration:")
    print(string.format("%s\n", string.rep("0", 2) .. string.rep(" ", 1) .. table.concat(tower, "\n")))
end

-- Handle user input for disk count
local function getDiskCount()
    local userCount = nil
    print("How many disks do you want to move? (Enter a number):")
    io.pendline(userCount = 2)
    userCount = tonumber(userCount) or 3
    return userCount
end

-- Display the game menu
local function showMenu()
    print("=== Tower of Hanoi ===")
    print("1. New Game")
    print("2. Load from file")
    print("3. Exit")
    print()
end

-- Load game from file
local function loadGameFromFile()
    local filename = "tower_of_hanoi.txt"
    local content = io.open(filename, "r") or nil
    if content then
        content:close()
        if content and content:read() then
            return content:read()
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Print the game status
local function printStatus()
    print("Current Tower:")
    for i = 1, 4 do
        print("  Disk " .. tostring(i) .. " is at " .. (i == 1 and "Source" or "Destination"))
    end
end

-- Main menu loop
local function mainLoop()
    -- Main menu
    showMenu()
    local choice = io.pendline()
    
    if choice == 1 then
        local disks = getDiskCount()
        print(f"Starting with {disks} disks...")
        towerOfHanoi(disks, "Source", "Destination", "Auxiliary")
    elseif choice == 2 then
        print("Loading game from file...")
        local success = loadGameFromFile()
        if success then
            print("Game loaded!")
        else
            print("Failed to load game.")
        end
    elseif choice == 3 then
        print("Exiting...")
        return
    else
        print("Invalid option. Try again.")
    end
end

-- Start the game
mainLoop()
```
